description: This file defines the TransactionManager class responsible for managing transaction states, including preparing, committing, and pinging transactions within Orleans distributed transactions framework.

classes.name: TransactionManager<TState>
classes.description: Manages transaction lifecycle including preparation, commit, and ping operations within Orleans transactions.

methods.name: PrepareAndCommit
methods.description: Validates lock, updates transaction record, and either aborts or commits the transaction.

methods.name: Prepared
methods.description: Notifies that a transaction has been prepared.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to keep the transaction alive or check its status.
